extension.summary: Movies and series for Lucent, with AIOStreams and Trakt
Films en series voor Lucent, met AIOStreams en Trakt
extension.description: Browse with TMDB, play through your own AIOStreams address and keep your progress on Trakt. Works without Seren.
Bladeren met TMDB, afspelen via je eigen AIOStreams-adres en je voortgang bijhouden op Trakt. Werkt zonder Seren.
extension.news: 0.18.0: Streaming services: a row with your services and six lists per service (new, popular and top rated movies and series). 0.17.1: New list: New series (started in the last four months). Without a key the main menu shows the setup assistant, and Settings and help always opens. 0.17.0: Coming soon for movies and series shows only what is still to come, nearest date first; the calendar shows episodes from today up to two months ahead. Library titles get every TMDB poster, logo and background (Choose art), and Lucent Video options in their context menu. New, tidier main menu and settings. 0.16.0: CocoScrapers as a source, played through Real-Debrid, AllDebrid, Premiumize or TorBox (enter your API key in the settings). Kids profiles with an age limit and a PIN. Search history per profile. "Watch trailer" in the context menu. Backup and restore of all Lucent Video settings. Automatic subtitle search when no subtitle in your language is found (the Lucent skin does this itself). 0.15.0: The library now follows every page of Trakt (no limit of 100), and you can choose what goes in it: collection, watchlist and/or your Trakt lists. 0.14.0: The library folders are added to Kodi automatically (new setting, on by default). 0.13.1: Clearer focus in the source window.
